text:
maria: Hey — noticed dashboards are sluggish on canary when multiple panels open. LCP jumps and charts repaint slowly.
aj: same, repro'd locally. Opening 8+ panels makes main thread spike.
sophie: any stack traces? is it render or parse?
maria: profiler shows long main-thread parse/compile around large JSON and a bunch of script evals. Not pure render.
chao: I think it's the new locales bundle (i18n/locales-all). It got included in a shared chunk yesterday and added ~700KB gz.
aj: yep. bundle analyzer shows locales:localesAll.js was pulled into charts vendor chunk because of a direct `import 'locales/all'` in the telemetry init.
kevin: who added that import? I remember we planned to lazy-load per route.
maria: PR #4123 by @kevin — he moved telemetry init earlier for metrics sampling; accidentally imported the whole locales file to format dates.
ops_lead: deploy-bot: canary-deploy 2024-10-12 16:40 rolled out. reactions: :warning:
devx-bot: Alert: frontend bundle > threshold (1MB) for canary build 2024-10-12T16:42Z
sophie: So telemetry init pulling locales triggers big parse on main thread, and telemetry itself is sampling and touching many dashboards, causing the cascade.
aj: quick mitigation: dynamic import the locales only when a panel needs it, and debounce telemetry init behind idle time.
chao: or move telemetry formatting into a worker so it doesn't block main thread. That avoids immediate removal of telemetry but keeps parsing async.
kevin: I'll open a quick PR to change `import 'locales/all'` to `const locales = await import('./locales/all')` behind `if (routeNeedsLocales)`.
maria: Also we should throttle telemetry client initialization for canary users. We have routing/telemetry quotas that are tuned for server-side but not client-side fanout.
aj: agree. Suggest adding a rollout flag: `telemetry.client.lazyInit=true` by default for non-enterprise. Then canary enterprise customers can opt-in.
ops_lead: Ops question: does delaying telemetry break any existing rollouts or tracing hooks?
sophie: tracing still starts earlier; telemetry client is just for enrichments/formatting. We'll keep traces and delay the heavy formatting.
kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4210 — quickfix that lazy-imports locales and defers telemetry init by 2000ms or onIdle.
maria: Nice. Can we also run a canary measurement: open 20 panels, measure LCP and main-thread time before/after patch?
aj: I'll run synthetic in eu-west-1 canary group.
chao: long term: split locales into per-locale chunks and ship only en by default. Also move metric formatting to worker and use structured telemetry API that accepts raw numbers and does client-side formatting off-main-thread.
ops_lead: Sounds good. For immediate rollback: do we want to revert PR #4123 or ship the lazy-load quickfix?
kevin: quickfix safer — smaller change. Rolling back telemetry init has risk.
maria: +1 quickfix and add a canary rollback monitor: if main-thread > 2s for 5% users revert.
devx-bot: canary-monitor: scheduled job created -> check 2h metric window.
aj: I'll post results in this thread once synthetic runs complete.
kevin: I'll cut the quickfix PR and link CI.
sophie: Thanks — appreciate the rapid triage. :thumbsup:
